rationale: Only Step 1 (QC) is actually specified; the DE and enrichment steps exist only as narrative sentences. The QC is strong and design-specific: library sizes, PCA/MDS with sample_01 annotated, an explicit keep-and-sensitivity policy, and a raw-vs-length-corrected integer check. The narrative names DESeq2 with apeglm on the 6v6 design plus a sample_01-removed sensitivity model and hallmark enrichment on a full ranked list, but states no design formula, reference level, contrast, low-count filter, BH alpha, ranking statistic, set-size window, gene set version, or software versions. Normalization is only implied by the DESeq2 name and an informational size-factor computation, and no final report contents are specified.
